whatItIs: A private, VY-hardcoded basket DEX: every pool is VY/<asset>, one shared VDAX LP token across all pools. Permissioned swaps (swapExactIn, onlySwapWhitelisted, constant-product VY/asset, value-conserving). NEW in this version: RESERVE_OFFICER_ROLE (held only by VRYO) gating two ASSET-ONLY primitives -- reserveInjectAsset(poolId,assetAmount) adds to pool.reserveAsset (VY leg untouched, NO VDAX minted -> existing holders own more asset pro-rata) and reserveExtractAsset(poolId,assetAmount,recipient) pulls asset (reverts if > reserveAsset, NO VDAX burned, pool never removed). These let VRYO deploy/recall reserve depth without a forced VY sale or VDAX mint; the MEV bot rebalances any price drift. Pre-existing admin LP ops (adminInjectLiquidity/adminExtractLiquidity, pro-rata both legs, mint/burn VDAX) unchanged.

fundFlow.swap: swapExactIn: whitelisted caller, VY<->asset constant-product, output -> recipient (value-conserving, k preserved). UNCHANGED from prior audit.
fundFlow.reserveOfficer: reserveInjectAsset: VRYO -> pool.reserveAsset (asset in). reserveExtractAsset: pool.reserveAsset -> recipient (VRYO hardcodes VRT). ASSET-ONLY, VY reserve never touched, no VDAX mint/burn.
fundFlow.admin: adminInjectLiquidity/adminExtractLiquidity (pro-rata both legs, mint/burn VDAX); updateSwapWhitelist; addPool; _authorizeUpgrade.
fundFlow.drainLevers: DAX pool ASSET reserves are drainable by: (1) ADMIN via adminExtractLiquidity (pro-rata, arbitrary recipient) -- pre-existing; (2) RESERVE_OFFICER (VRYO-only) via reserveExtractAsset (asset-only, arbitrary recipient). VY reserves drainable only by ADMIN (adminExtract) or value-conserving swaps.
